categories.main_business_segments: The Group operates primarily in pharmaceuticals, including research and development, production, and sales. Its main segments are intermediate products, bulk medicine, finished products, animal healthcare, and big health products such as dietary supplements and medical devices. The company also engages in biopharmaceuticals and medical devices manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group utilizes integrated pharmaceutical manufacturing technologies including chemical synthesis for antibiotics and biopharmaceuticals, recombinant protein drug development, and advanced production methods for veterinary drugs and medical devices. It emphasizes vertically integrated production from intermediate products to finished pharmaceuticals, with ongoing automation and intelligent production upgrades.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves pharmaceutical distributors, healthcare providers, and animal healthcare markets including livestock, poultry, aquatic products, and pets. It targets both human and veterinary pharmaceutical markets, with key products in diabetes care, anti-infection, and animal health. Major markets include hospitals, pharmacies, and animal healthcare sectors domestically and internationally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates mainly in China including Hong Kong, with production bases in multiple Chinese regions. It has a global sales network covering nearly 80 countries and regions, with significant overseas markets in Europe, India, Middle East, South America, Southeast Asia, Latin America, the Middle East, and Africa. It also actively expands international presence through strategic partnerships and overseas registrations.
categories.supply_chain_position: The Group operates a vertically integrated supply chain covering upstream intermediate products and bulk medicine manufacturing, midstream finished pharmaceutical products, and downstream sales and distribution. It controls production from raw materials to finished drugs and veterinary products, enabling cost control and quality assurance across the supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group prioritizes innovation-driven development with over 100 R&D projects, including 22 Class 1 new drugs in clinical stages focusing on endocrinology, metabolism, autoimmunity, anti-infection, and ophthalmology. It invests heavily in new drug development, clinical trials, and consistency evaluation of generics, while expanding new drug pipelines and licensing out projects globally. The company also develops big health and animal healthcare product lines.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of pharmaceuticals, including intermediate products, bulk medicines, finished drugs, animal healthcare products, and health supplements. Sales occur via contracts with customers, including tenders and centralized procurement, with revenue recognized at delivery. The company also benefits from government subsidies and grants related to R&D and capital expenditures.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The Group is positioned as a leading integrated pharmaceutical company in China with strong market leadership in intermediate products, bulk medicine, and finished pharmaceuticals. It competes in both domestic and international markets, maintaining a competitive edge through vertical integration, R&D innovation, and strategic partnerships. It ranks among the top 100 pharmaceutical enterprises in China and holds industry-leading ESG ratings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 2024, the Group reported revenue of approximately RMB 13.76 billion, stable compared to 2023, with profit attributable to owners at RMB 2.66 billion. It has shown steady growth over five years with expanding total assets reaching RMB 25.83 billion and equity of RMB 14.39 billion. The company maintains a robust financial position with increasing liquidity and controlled finance costs.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The Group emphasizes high-quality, efficient pharmaceutical products supported by strong R&D capabilities and a vertically integrated production model. It offers innovative drugs, including several Class 1 new drugs, and a broad product portfolio covering human and animal health. Its global strategic layout, comprehensive product pipeline, and commitment to sustainable development and ESG leadership differentiate it in the competitive pharmaceutical industry.
